name: Stray Sheep ~Samayou Kohitsuji-tachi no Yoru~
original_name: Stray Sheep ～彷徨う子羊たちの夜～
source:
Main character is a professional seducer who receives requests to corrupt women. This time the target is Roppongi number one hostess Aizawa Fumika who he approaches without checking her background. However a murder happens just in the middle of investigation...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名职业诱惑者，接受了腐败女性的请求。这次的目标是六本木第一女主人相泽富美香，他在没有调查她背景的情况下就接近了她。然而，就在调查过程中，却发生了一起谋杀案……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
